segments.text: The appearance of your precious childhood friend, who has become a karate girl overflowing with a sense of justice.

Wearing her hair in a ponytail, she has been attending the "Hayama Karate Dojo," which is run by the protagonist's grandfather, since before starting school. Now her karate skills are far beyond yours, and that has given her confidence. She has also been mentally tempered, appearing calm and composed on the surface.

However, in reality, her core personality hasn't changed, and she still has a tendency to act impulsively due to a lack of foresight. Thinking "I have to protect the dojo, so I'll face off against Shouya Kiryuu!" is a prime example of this. Although she tries to act dignified and stays conscious of her outward appearance, she often loses her composure and shows her true self when she is with protagonist.

Her body has been forged through martial arts, while maintaining a slender suppleness, her feminine softness increases day by day. While she cherishes a pure relationship with protagonist, she is secretly troubled and ashamed of the fact that her body is susceptible to pleasure and that she harbors strong, hidden sexual desires. She also remains unaware of just how incredibly attractive her physique appears to males other than yourself.
This is the appearance of your precious childhood friend, who has become an energetic swimming girl.

With her hair cut short and her skin tanned to a bronze glow, she joined the swimming club after entering the academy. In an environment where she didn't have to think about anything difficult and could simply focus on achieving good results, she enjoyed the sport freely and lightheartedly.

Recently, however, she has started wanting to go to the same higher education institution as the protagonist and has begun aiming for a sports recommendation (scholarship). While only her body has matured, her lack of foresight from childhood remains unchanged, resulting in a personality that is easily deceived by "bad males." Furthermore, she still refers to herself using the masculine/childish first-person pronoun "Boku," just as she did when she was little.

Your precious childhood friend has become a serious, hardworking, indoor-type studious girl. She has grown her hair long and wears glasses. Since entering the academy, without getting involved in sports or anything like that, she has focused solely on studying for entrance exams. Actually, she isn't naturally gifted, but through extraordinary effort, she maintains "above-average" grades.

However, as she became more conscious of protagonist as a member of the opposite sex, her study time decreased, and her grades began to drop. In order to go to the same higher education institution as you, she begged her parents for a private tutor. Perhaps because she lacks an outlet like sports, she has the most repressed or "twisted" sexual desire among the three routes.

While keeping her feelings for the protagonist hidden, deep down in her heart, she also thinks, "I want to experience that soon." There is no way "bad males" would overlook such a perverted girl with such a serious face.

Ryou is the protagonist of this work. He is Aina’s childhood friend and relative, and they grew up together like siblings of the same age. Since they were young, he has always looked out for the shy Aina, and he grew up harboring a faint affection for her.
Ryou's grandfather privately runs a karate dojo called the "Hayama-style Karate Dojo," where Ryou himself studies karate. However, his skills in the martial arts are not particularly noteworthy.

Regardless of the route the story takes, he becomes highly conscious of Aina’s erotically developed body. Fearing that their current comfortable relationship might be ruined, he finds it difficult to move their connection forward.

Shouya is a delinquent youth who has been causing trouble since childhood, relying on his father's power and influence. His father is a wealthy man with deep political connections and the owner of "Kiryuu Fitness School," a comprehensive sports gym chain with locations nationwide. He is currently attempting to take over the "Hayama-style Karate Dojo" managed by the protagonist's grandfather.

In truth, Shouya is the son of his father's first wife. He harbors complex emotions regarding the fact that his younger half-brother, born to his father and his second wife, is doted upon and beloved by the rest of the family.

While he inwardly loathes his father for covering up his misdeeds and acting as if they never happened just to protect his own reputation, Shouya finds himself developing an increasingly twisted affection for Aina, who is the only one to confront his actions head-on.

Tsuyoshi is a 42-year-old single man with a sturdy and muscular physique. He serves as the advisor for the academy's swim club. Although rumors of sexual harassment constantly surround him, his proven ability to lead the swim club to national-level success has earned him the deep trust of the school's upper management. He has an assertive and reckless personality. On the other hand, he is surprisingly good at looking after others, possessing an old-fashioned sense of manliness that leads him to protect his own circle.
